messages:
cust_bolt: Hey team — after we pinned a model for our account yesterday, our downstream indexer started throwing a shape assertion: expected 1536, got 1024. Nothing else changed on our side.

maria-support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact API request/response and which model/version you pinned?

cust_bolt: Here are the important bits:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{\n  \"model\": \"embed-customer-v2\",\n  \"input\": [\"foo\", \"bar\"]\n}
```
Response: vectors length = 1024 each. We previously had 1536 vectors from before pin. We pinned to "embed-customer-v2@2026-03-01" via the Console.

jake-engineer: Did you get a model metadata payload earlier? `GET /v1/models/embed-customer-v2` should include an `embedding_dim` field. Can you run that and paste the output?

cust_bolt: Ran that now, got `embedding_dim: 1024`. But our integration expects 1536. We never saw a deprecation notice. This was a silent variant swap during the pin.

li-ml: Two quick checks: (1) Are you using batching (multiple inputs in one request)? (2) Any chance the Console pin used an alias that points to a newer variant (quantized / memory-optimized) with smaller output size?

cust_bolt: We use batching in production. We also use the pinned variant to stabilize outputs. The Console UI showed the alias `embed-customer-v2` -> `embed-customer-v2@stable` when we pinned. No obvious warning.

ops-bot: Alert: model-variant-change detected for account cust_bolt — fallback variant `embed-customer-v2-quant` served 2% of requests in the last 30m.

maria-support: That ops-bot note aligns with internal telemetry. Jake / Li — can you check if the pinned version resolved to the quantized variant on reservation? If so that's likely the cause: quantized variant outputs reduced-dimension vectors for space-saving.

jake-engineer: Confirmed on infra logs: the alias `embed-customer-v2@stable` was routed to `embed-customer-v2-quant@2026-03-01` in a capacity fallback for some pods. Batching path sometimes routes to a different execution kernel which, in this model family, returns 1024-dim vectors.

li-ml: Impact & fixes: 1) Short term — re-pin the alias to the known full-dimension variant `embed-customer-v2@2026-02-20` (we can do this for you) OR pad/resize vectors client-side (unsafe for semantic similarity). 2) Medium — we will add an explicit `embedding_dim` check during model alias resolution and reject variant swaps that change output dimension for pinned aliases. 3) Long term — prevent cross-variant routing for pinned reservations unless backward compatible.

cust_bolt: We need a short-term rollback. Can you re-pin to the previous stable variant and confirm? Also we need a postmortem — this broke a customer-facing search index.

maria-support: On it. Jake — initiating rollback to `embed-customer-v2@2026-02-20` for cust_bolt now.

jake-engineer: Done. I've re-pointed the alias and triggered a pod drain/failover. Can you re-run your embedding call?

cust_bolt: Rerun — confirmed vectors are 1536 now. Indexer resumed. Thank you.

maria-support: I'm filing an internal incident and tagging eng/runtime + eng-ml. We'll follow up with a timeline and permanent mitigation. For immediate hygiene: check your integration to validate `embedding_dim` on model metadata during startup and fail-safe on mismatches (alert + pause ingest).

cust_bolt: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep us posted on the postmortem and any changes to Console pinning UX/warnings. :heart:

li-ml: Noted — we'll include a Console banner and a warning modal for any alias/variant change that alters `embedding_dim`.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0493 — routing-induced embedding-dim-change for cust_bolt.

maria-support: Closing this thread for now since rollback resolved the immediate outage. We'll DM with timeline updates. If you notice any residual mismatches, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
